gwt.given: A DataConnectionManager's connection has RetryCount 6 and no RetryLengthening or RetryInterval override, so GetRetryTimespan falls back to its default Lengthening progression (1, 3, 5, 7… × interval) with a 250 ms interval — the exact per-attempt durations this produces (250 ms for attempt 1, 750 ms for attempt 2) are established by the Connection Configuration Hierarchy's own GetRetryTimespan scenario — and the data provider classifies a particular DbException as transient.
gwt.when: A command execution on that connection throws that DbException on its first two attempts and succeeds on the third.
gwt.then: The manager retries twice, pausing 250 ms before the second attempt and 750 ms before the third, then returns the third attempt's result to the caller; the DbException never surfaces.
